2. SCOPE OF WORK EXECUTED
Bridges Flyovers works for Arunodaya Infrastructure completed 2023.
The work was carried out under site conditions that included hard rock encountered below the founding level over part of the alignment.
The agency organised its resources around this without recourse to the department for additional assistance, and the programme was
re-sequenced locally to keep the critical path intact.
An extension of time was granted during execution on account of diversion of a live utility main discovered during excavation. The delay
was examined by this office and held to be beyond the agency's control; no compensation was claimed and none has been paid.
The above work was executed under the supervision of the undersigned in accordance with the approved drawings, specifications, and
the terms and conditions of the contract. The work has been completed in all respects and has been got inspected by the Engineer-in-
Chief / Superintending Engineer.
3. QUALITY ASSESSMENT
The overall quality of the completed work is graded Satisfactory. Workmanship was satisfactory after remedial work on the first pour,
and third-party inspection was arranged for the structural elements. Materials were drawn from approved sources and the test results
filed with this office were within the limits prescribed in the contract specification.

5. DEFICIENCY / OBSERVATION LIST
At the time of taking over, kerb alignment corrected over a 40 m stretch after joint inspection. Regarding site safety, the site maintained
its safety induction register without lapse. The agency's conduct during the contract is recorded as professional, though correspondence
on variations was occasionally slow.
Nil. No major deficiencies observed during the final inspection carried out on 2023-07-12. All minor observations pointed out during the
interim inspections have been rectified to the satisfaction of the inspecting authority.
6. RECOMMENDATION
Having satisfied myself as to the quantity and quality of the work executed, and on the basis of the joint measurements recorded in the
measurement book, I certify the work complete and recommend release of the balance payment together with the retention money due
on expiry of the defect liability period. Certified by T. Raghavan, Superintending Engineer.
The agency attended to all observations raised during execution and the work was taken over on satisfactory completion of the final
inspection.
This certificate is issued for the sole purpose of recording completion of the above work and does not absolve the contractor of any obligations under the contract,
including the defect liability period.
